engineExpertQuestions.label: Web framework — e.g. React + Vite (default), Vue, Angular, vanilla
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Capacitor wraps any web app. React + Vite is the most common pairing; the Engine Expert will tailor architecture notes to whichever you choose.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Target platforms — ios, android, or both
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Determines which native projects to maintain and which Capacitor plugins to include.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Native features needed — e.g. camera, push notifications, biometrics, file system, none
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Each native feature requires a Capacitor plugin. Listing them up front lets the Engine Expert flag any community vs. official plugin tradeoffs.

engineExpertQuestions.label: OTA update strategy — Capawesome Live Update, Appflow, none
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Capacitor supports live JS bundle updates without a store release. If you plan to use this, the Engine Expert will add configuration notes.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Authentication — none, OAuth/OIDC (social login), email+password, biometric
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Affects which Capacitor plugins and secure storage patterns the Engine Expert recommends.
